adept_core.table.blade.desc: Speed and combos. A field blade with focus sockets.
adept_core.table.hammer.desc: Power and crowd control. Charged piston strike.
adept_core.table.hammer.later: The hammer prototype comes in a later version.
adept_core.table.choose.hint: Choose your melee weapon. The other option stays locked for the whole playthrough.
adept_core.table.result.not_chosen: Choose the pair and build the prototype first
adept_core.resonator.none: The resonator is silent: no nodes in range
adept_core.camp.wrong_world: The camp can only be deployed in the overworld
adept_core.camp.already: A camp is already deployed — fold it first (sneak + use the rig)
adept_core.camp.no_node: No dormant node nearby (must be within %s blocks of the crystal)
adept_core.camp.no_space: Not enough room for the rig and the gateway
adept_core.camp.deployed: Camp deployed. Level %s node, waves: %s. Stay close or extraction pauses.
adept_core.camp.folded_early: Camp folded before cleansing: extraction progress lost
adept_core.camp.broken: The extraction rig is broken! Repair it (use an iron ingot on it)
adept_core.wave.final: Final wave %s of %s — the node guardian is coming
adept_core.trader.not_cleansed: The trader can only be called from a cleansed node
adept_core.trader.already: The trader was already called from this node
adept_core.step.blade.emitter.edge.1.des: The blade field gets denser. Every direct hit with the blade in your main hand deals %s more damage, %s per hit in total.
adept_core.blade.stats: %s damage per hit, %s hits per second.
adept_core.blade.steps: Upgrades are shown on the artifact table.
adept_core.table.heavy.desc: Plates soak most damage, servos run on electricity. Built for long fights.
adept_core.table.light.desc: Mana shield and dashes. Built for bursts.
adept_core.table.gauss.desc: A stream of needles from a magazine; the barrel heats up.
adept_core.table.choose.hint.0: Choose a melee weapon. The other option stays locked for the whole playthrough.
adept_core.table.choose.hint.1: Choose your armor. The other option stays locked for the whole playthrough.
adept_core.table.choose.hint.2: Choose a ranged weapon. The other option stays locked for the whole playthrough.
adept_core.table.light.later: The light exosuit prototype comes in a later version.
adept_core.table.rail.later: The railgun prototype comes in a later version.
adept_core.step.heavy.chest.bastion.1.de: An intact plate absorbs %1$s%% of its share of damage (%2$s%% without this step). The rest reaches your health; a broken plate lets its whole share through.
adept_core.step.gauss.barrel.tempo.1.des: The gun fires faster: up to %1$s shots per second instead of %2$s.
adept_core.heavy.part.head: Head
adept_core.heavy.install: To fit a plate: armor in main hand, plate in off hand, right-click.
adept_core.gauss.hint: Right-click to fire. Shift + right-click to switch template and reload. Charges at the base.
adept_core.gauss_table.title: Gauss gun: segment upgrades
adept_core.gauss_table.open.desc: Six segments. Each has two paths of three steps and an apex.
adept_core.gauss_table.hint: Drag to rotate. Scroll to zoom.
adept_core.gauss_table.choose: Pick a segment under the model. Its two paths and apex will show here.
adept_core.gauss_table.details.segment: Pick a segment, then a step.
adept_core.gauss_table.details.node: Pick a step or the apex to see its description and cost.
adept_core.gauss_table.pending: Changes the look only for now (slice 4).
adept_core.step.gauss.barrel.boost.1.des: Needles fly 30%% faster and farther: 62 blocks instead of 48.
adept_core.step.gauss.barrel.boost.2.des: Needles ignore 30%% of the target's armor.
adept_core.step.gauss.barrel.boost.3.des: A needle pierces the first target and keeps flying. The second target takes 70%% damage.
adept_core.step.gauss.barrel.tempo.2.des: Autofire: while the button is held the gun fires on its own, 5 shots per second.
adept_core.step.gauss.barrel.tempo.3.des: Spin-up: over 2 seconds of continuous fire the rate grows by 50%%.
adept_core.step.gauss.barrel.apex.1.name: Apex: Arc Discharge
adept_core.step.gauss.barrel.apex.1.desc: A hit has a 25%% chance to strike the nearest enemy within 6 blocks with lightning: 50%% damage and the rune effect. Fire rate and range +15%%.
A shot kicks the aim up half as much.
Spread does not grow while running.
adept_core.step.gauss.coils.economy.1.de: A shot uses 15%% less electricity: 3.4 instead of 4.
adept_core.step.gauss.coils.economy.2.de: Another 15%% less: a shot costs 2.8 electricity.
adept_core.step.gauss.coils.economy.3.de: Every fifth shot uses no electricity.
adept_core.step.gauss.coils.apex.1.name: Apex: Impulse
adept_core.step.gauss.coils.apex.1.desc: During continuous fire every tenth needle is empowered: double damage, pierces 2 targets. Accuracy and economy +15%%.
The barrel heats 20%% slower: 4%% per shot instead of 5%%.
Bursts of up to 5 shots do not heat the barrel.
adept_core.step.gauss.cooler.purge.1.des: Emergency heat purge: heat drops to zero at once. Cooldown 20 seconds.
adept_core.step.gauss.cooler.purge.2.des: The purge scalds enemies within 3 blocks with steam: 4 damage.
adept_core.step.gauss.cooler.purge.3.des: Purge cooldown is 12 seconds instead of 20.
adept_core.step.gauss.cooler.apex.1.name: Apex: Mana Circuit
adept_core.step.gauss.cooler.apex.1.desc: When overheated the gun keeps firing on mana: 6 mana per shot. Heatsink +15%%.
adept_core.step.gauss.battery.capacity.1: 600 electricity instead of 400. Enough for 150 shots.
adept_core.step.gauss.battery.recuperati: Killing an elite enemy returns 60 electricity.
The mana converter loses 25%% instead of 50%%.
adept_core.step.gauss.battery.apex.1.des: At 90%% charge or more you can release 300 electricity as a 5-block ring: 8 damage, enemies are pushed away and stunned for 2 seconds. Capacity and recovery +15%%.
The magazine holds 45 needles instead of 30.
adept_core.step.gauss.magazine.pattern.1: A second magazine template. Switched with a key, applies on the next reload.
adept_core.step.gauss.magazine.pattern.2: Each template gets its own rule for missing needles: skip the slot, take any needle, or stop loading.
adept_core.step.gauss.magazine.pattern.3: A shot has a 20%% chance not to use up a needle.
adept_core.step.gauss.magazine.apex.1.de: Switching the template reloads the magazine at once; needles of the old order return to the inventory. Cooldown 10 seconds. Volume +15%%, reload 1.7 seconds instead of 2.
adept_core.step.gauss.scope.lens.1.name: Lens I
adept_core.step.gauss.scope.lens.2.name: Lens II
adept_core.step.gauss.scope.lens.2.desc: A weak-point hit deals another +30%% damage.
adept_core.step.gauss.scope.lens.3.name: Lens III
adept_core.step.gauss.scope.scanner.2.de: Targets within 12 blocks are visible through walls.
adept_core.step.gauss.scope.scanner.3.de: Targets show weak points. Hitting one deals +25%% damage.
adept_core.step.gauss.scope.apex.1.name: Apex: Mark
adept_core.step.gauss.scope.apex.1.desc: Needles that miss are pulled to the marked target if they pass within 2 blocks of it. Highlight range and weak-point bonus +15%%.
adept_core.component.variant.magic: Held together by runes and crystals, charged with mana
adept_core.component.variant.tech: Plain alloy, no runes, charged with electricity
adept_core.component.no_recipe: No recipe yet. Get it with /adept component
adept_core.accumulator.hint: Keep it in your inventory: artifacts draw charge from it on their own.
adept_core.cauldron.hint: Right-click: souls from the vessel into the furnace. Shift + right-click: swap the vessel with the one in your off hand.
adept_core.vessel.hint: To put it into the soul cauldron, hold the vessel in your off hand and shift + right-click with the cauldron.
adept_core.table.singles.hint: Single artifacts have no pair. Build them at any time, and again if one is lost.
adept_core.table.accumulator.desc: Carried in the inventory. Mana and electricity sit in two separate stores and flow into artifacts without loss. At the base it charges from the base stores.
adept_core.table.soul_cauldron.desc: Carried in the inventory. Mobs you kill leave souls. The cauldron collects them when you are close, burns them into mana and passes it to the accumulator. Now and then the furnace yields a soul core, the Alliance currency.
adept_core.step.accumulator.core.capacit: Each accumulator store (mana and electricity) holds %1$s instead of %2$s.
adept_core.step.cauldron.furnace.yield.1: The furnace draws %1$s%% more mana from a soul: a normal one gives %2$s, a strong one %3$s, a guardian soul %4$s.
